newsitem.title: USA: Foamex International unit sells 144A notes.
newsitem.headline: Foamex International unit sells 144A notes.

text.p: The following 144A issue from Foamex LP, a unit of Foamex International Inc, was priced in the 144A private placement market on Thursday via lead manager Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette Securities Corp, according to market sources. BORROWER FOAMEX LP AMT $150 MLN COUPON 9.875 PCT MATURITY 6/15/2007
TYPE SNR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100.00 FIRST PAY DATE 12/15/1997 LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 9.875 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P SPREAD +308.5 BP CALLABLE NON-CALL FIVE
NOTE: THE NOTES HAVE A THREE-YEAR EQUITY CALL FOR 35 PERCENT AT 109.875. THE NOTES ARE EXPECTED TO BE RATED B-MINUS BY STANDARD AND POOR'S. ((--U.S. Corporate Bond Unit, 212 859-1678))
